annotations.title: Save a chart to my account

description: Save a new birth chart to the signed-in user's AstroLogics account so it appears in their saved charts on the website and app. Only call this when the user asks to save a chart. Saving the same birth details again returns the existing chart.

name.description: Name for the chart, for example "Priya" or "Mom".

place_name.description: Birth place name as the user gave it.

relationship.description: Optional relationship to the user, for example "self", "spouse", "mother".

time.description: Local birth time, HH:MM. Defaults to 12:00 if unknown.

name: save_chart
title: Save a chart to my account
